title: Zimbardo's Stanford Prison Experiment

tellings.quote: And Philip Zimbardo at Stanford with the Stanford Prison Experiment, like all very similar.

plain: Michels brings up the Stanford Prison Experiment of 1971, in which the psychologist Philip Zimbardo had students play prison guards and prisoners, as 'all very similar' to other projects he was discussing. He mentions it himself, in passing and without a source, in a 2026 episode about UFO secrecy and a secret society. He places it alongside those projects as part of a pattern of experiments on how people behave.
